detail.longDescription: SMTP was built in 1982 for a few hundred friendly hosts. Every problem since got a new layer instead of a fix: MIME, IMAP, blocklists, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS. Most of them fail silently. Mail just goes to spam. I wrote up how email got hard, and how inbuxa makes it right by default. https:// jcoffey.dev/articles/how-email -got-hard/ # inbuxa # Email # SelfHosted # DMARC
